decisions.decision: The poll was not removed, so keep the check and re-point it. Polls still ship: `app/src/lib/examples/data/real-polls.ts` is in `MAPS` in `examples/index.ts`, the "Polls" category exists in `categories.ts` (`live-polls`, `giveaway-diagnostic`), and `session-room.tsx` still renders the Polls tab with `.lx-poll-o` / `.lx-poll-v`. The default view simply shows no session room with a poll. In `app/scripts/probe-library.mjs`, make 'poll accepts a vote' first open a view that contains a poll: navigate the library UI to the Polls category / `live-polls` template (or its deep link if one exists), wait for `.lx-room`, then run the existing vote steps. Keep 'no poll found' as a real failure. If the poll view cannot be reached on the live build, treat that as a library bug and fix it. Run the probe against the live centre and the mirror, commit with the reason, push to main, log in `coord/LOG.md`, and set T-385 to review for Bharath.
decisions.why: T-385 spec offers drop, re-point or restore. Code read today shows polls still built and rendered; coord/LOG.md 2026-10-09 says only the default view lacks one. Library v3 (bc246d4) changed the home view, so the check is stale.
